'''Warok''' was a water spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. He tormented the proud by slipping into their huts and dousing them with water during rainstorms. "Warok" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Warok/Legends|the warrior]] who fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
